canonical_json: UTF-8 without BOM; object keys sorted; compact separators; ensure_ascii=false; exactly one trailing LF

digest_rules.row_digest: SHA-256 of canonical finding row before row_digest is added
digest_rules.set_digest: SHA-256 of canonical sorted digest array; duplicates preserved

multiset_rule: sort digest values lexically and preserve duplicates
occurrence_rule: AST source span plus one-based ordinal among equal scanner path, symbol, method, operation, table, and fingerprint values
